messages.content: The Q2 revenue for Quillmark Software was $4.2M, up 18% year-over-year. Operating expenses were $3.1M, driven primarily by R&D ($1.8M) and sales and marketing ($0.9M). Net income was $1.1M, compared to $0.6M in Q2 of last year. Cash on hand is $6.4M. Headcount grew from 42 to 51.
